title: [GMCP 203.024.04] Adversarial and failure behavior: Unified policy engine and least-privilege authorization
goal: Requirement GMCP-203-024-04. Close validation, authorization, isolation, privacy, bounded-resource, cancellation, concurrency, crash, retry, rollback, and recovery behavior. Add deterministic negative, attack, race, corruption, and fault-injection fixtures derived from the vector threat model. Vector outcome: One deny-by-default policy engine mediates discovery, invocation, callbacks, data flow and installation using principal, server, capability, arguments, resource, destination, time, risk and provenance. Delegation uses attenuated capability grants, policy decisions explain their exact rule and version, TOCTOU is prevented by execution-time re-check, and exhaustive architecture tests prove no production bypass. Done means production-path tests and retained evidence prove this work package; task closure or roadmap wording alone is not evidence.
